g.cata_name AS category_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar), '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar) AS integer) ELSE 0 END AS category_sort_order, w.cata_type_code, w.code_name, w.reg_term, CASE WHEN w.use_at = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cu.user_nm), ''), CAST(w.created_by AS varchar)) AS created_by, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(pre.updated_at, pre.created_at, w.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at, CONCAT('검토:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ru.user_nm), ''), '-'), ' / 승인:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(au.user_nm), ''), '-')) AS owner, CASE WHEN COALESCE(wa.assignee_count, 0) = 0 THEN '-' WHEN wa.assignee_count = 1 THEN wa.first_assignee_name ELSE wa.first_assignee_name || ' 외 ' || CAST(wa.assignee_count - 1 AS varchar) || '명' END AS assignee_summary, COALESCE(wa.assignee_ids_csv, '') AS assignee_ids_csv, '' AS reference_ids_csv, w.reviewer_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ru.user_nm), ''), '') AS reviewer_name, w.approver_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(au.user_nm), ''), '') AS approver_name, CASE WHEN w.reviewer_id IS NOT NULL AND w.approver_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS assignee_mapped, CAST(w.drafting_work_template_json AS text) AS template_json, w.drafting_work_template_html AS template_html, CASE WHEN w.drafting_work_template_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(w.drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_document, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS todo_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'in_progress' WHEN COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'approved' WHEN COALESCE(appr.pre_apply_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'pre_apply' ELSE 'pre_apply' END AS approval_status_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN '진행중' WHEN COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN '완료' WHEN COALESCE(appr.rejected_count, 0) > 0 THEN '반송' ELSE '미완료' END AS approval_status_type_name, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latest_status_at ,'' AS drafter_app_status ,'' AS reviewer_app_status ,'' AS approver_app_status ,FALSE AS is_owner ,FALSE AS is_actor_turn ,TRUE AS read_only ,FALSE AS can_temp_save ,FALSE AS can_submit ,FALSE AS can_submit_cancel ,FALSE AS can_approve ,FALSE AS can_confirm FROM tb_drafting_work_category w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND cu.login_id = w.created_by LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ru.login_id = w.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND au.login_id = w.approver_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS assignee_count, STRING_AGG(a.employee_no, ',' ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id) AS assignee_ids_csv, (ARRAY_AGG( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(um.user_nm), ''), a.employee_no) ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id ))[1] AS first_assignee_name FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a LEFT JOIN tb_user um ON um.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND ( CAST(um.user_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no OR CAST(um.login_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no ) WHERE a.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) wa ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pre_apply_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, MAX(COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at)) AS latest_updated_at, MAX(m.electronic_approval_id) AS latest_approval_id FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) appr ON TRUE WHERE w.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ) AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at) DESC, w.drafting_work_category_id DESC

assignee_count, STRING_AGG(a.employee_no, ',' ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id) AS assignee_ids_csv, (ARRAY_AGG( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(um.user_nm), ''), a.employee_no) ORDER BY 'MONTHLY') THEN date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') IN ('주', '매주', 'week', 'WEEK', 'weekly', 'WEEKLY') THEN date_trunc('week', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE date_trunc('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) END AS cycle_start ) SELECT m.electronic_approval_id, m.ea_exe_id, m.ea_title, m.status_type, m.login_id, m.txt_cnt, m.txt_json, m.after_cnt, m.after_txt_json, m.twf_date, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m CROSS JOIN cycle_base cb WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) >= cb.cycle_start ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) pre ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(li.login_id AS varchar), ',' ORDER BY li.exe_seq) AS reference_ids_csv FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info li WHERE li.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND li.electronic_approval_id = pre.electronic_approval_id AND COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'cooperated' AND li.login_id != pre.login_id AND COALESCE(li.last_owner_status, '') != 'Y' ) ref ON TRUE LEFT JOIN tb_user cu_pre ON cu_pre.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND cu_pre.login_id = pre.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_electronic_approval_line_info l2 ON l2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND l2.electronic_approval_id = pre.electronic_approval_id AND l2.exe_seq = 2 AND COALESCE(l2.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' LEFT JOIN tb_electronic_approval_line_info l3 ON l3.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND l3.electronic_approval_id = pre.electronic_approval_id AND l3.exe_seq = 3 AND COALESCE(l3.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' LEFT JOIN tb_user ru_line ON ru_line.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ru_line.login_id = l2.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_user au_line ON au_line.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND au_line.login_id = l3.login_id WHERE w.drafting_work_category_id = #{id} AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y'

SELECT w.drafting_work_category_id, m.electronic_approval_id, COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, '') AS ea_exe_id, COALESCE(m.ea_title, '') AS title, t.tenant_code, w.drafting_work_category_group_id, g.cata_code, g.cata_name AS category_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar), '') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(g.view_seq::varchar) AS integer) ELSE 0 END AS category_sort_order, w.cata_type_code, w.code_name, w.reg_term, CASE WHEN w.use_at = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(cu_main.user_id AS varchar)), ''), CAST(m.login_id AS varchar) ) AS created_by, TO_CHAR( COALESCE( CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(m.twf_date), '') ~ '^[0-9]{8}$' THEN TO_DATE(NULLIF(TRIM(m.twf_date), ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE NULL END, DATE(m.updated_at), DATE(m.created_at), DATE(w.created_at) ), 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS created_at, CONCAT( '검토:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ru_line.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(ru.user_nm), ''), '-'), ' / 승인:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(au_line.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(au.user_nm), ''), '-') ) AS owner, CASE WHEN COALESCE(wa.assignee_count, 0) = 0 THEN '-' WHEN wa.assignee_count = 1 THEN wa.first_assignee_name ELSE wa.first_assignee_name || ' 외 ' || CAST(wa.assignee_count - 1 AS varchar) || '명' END AS assignee_summary, COALESCE(wa.assignee_ids_csv, '') AS assignee_ids_csv, COALESCE(ref.reference_ids_csv, '') AS reference_ids_csv, COALESCE(ru_line.user_id, w.reviewer_id) AS reviewer_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ru_line.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(ru.user_nm), ''), '') AS reviewer_name, COALESCE(au_line.user_id, w.approver_id) AS approver_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(au_line.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(au.user_nm), ''), '') AS approver_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ru_line.user_id, w.reviewer_id) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(au_line.user_id, w.approver_id) IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS assignee_mapped, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.after_txt_json AS text)), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.txt_json AS text)), ''), CAST(w.drafting_work_template_json AS text) ) AS template_json, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(m.after_cnt), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(m.txt_cnt), ''), w.drafting_work_template_html ) AS template_html, CASE WHEN m.after_txt_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(m.after_cnt, '')), '') IS NOT NULL OR m.txt_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(m.txt_cnt, '')), '') IS NOT NULL OR w.drafting_work_template_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(w.drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_document, COALESCE(m.status_type, '') AS approval_status_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN '진행중' WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN '완료' WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN '반송' WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN '미완료' ELSE '' END AS approval_status_type_name, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latest_status_at, COALESCE(l1.app_status, '') AS drafter_app_status, COALESCE(l2.app_status, '') AS reviewer_app_status, COALESCE(l3.app_status, '') AS approver_app_status, CASE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_owner, CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info turn_line WHERE turn_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND turn_line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND turn_line.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(turn_line.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' AND turn_line.arrival_at IS NOT NULL AND turn_line.exe_at IS NULL ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_actor_turn, CASE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN FALSE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' AND COALESCE(cancel_perm.final_owner_confirmed_flag, 0) = 1 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS read_only, CASE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN TRUE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' AND COALESCE(cancel_perm.final_owner_confirmed_flag, 0) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS can_temp_save, CASE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN TRUE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' AND COALESCE(cancel_perm.final_owner_confirmed_flag, 0) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS can_submit, CASE WHEN #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN COALESCE(cancel_perm.final_owner_confirmed_flag, 0) = 1 THEN FALSE WHEN cancel_perm.latest_completed_seq IS NULL OR cancel_perm.latest_completed_seq <= 0 THEN FALSE WHEN cancel_perm.actor_latest_completed_seq IS NULL OR cancel_perm.actor_latest_completed_seq <= 0 THEN FALSE WHEN cancel_perm.latest_completed_seq = cancel_perm.actor_latest_completed_seq THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS can_submit_cancel, CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info turn_line WHERE turn_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND turn_line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND turn_line.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(turn_line.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' AND turn_line.arrival_at IS NOT NULL AND turn_line.exe_at IS NULL ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS can_approve ,CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') IN ('in_progress', 'approved', 'rejected') AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info turn_line WHERE turn_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND turn_line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND turn_line.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(turn_line.muldec_status, '') = 'cooperated' AND turn_line.arrival_at IS NOT NULL AND turn_line.exe_at IS NULL ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS can_confirm FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m JOIN tb_drafting_work_category w ON w.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND w.drafting_work_category_id = m.drafting_work_category_id JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND CAST(cu.user_id AS varchar) = CAST(w.created_by AS varchar) LEFT JOIN tb_user cu_main ON cu_main.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND cu_main.login_id = m.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND CAST(ru.user_id AS varchar) = CAST(w.reviewer_id AS varchar) LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND CAST(au.user_id AS varchar) = CAST(w.approver_id AS varchar) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS assignee_count, STRING_AGG(a.employee_no, ',' ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id) AS assignee_ids_csv, (ARRAY_AGG( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(um.user_nm), ''), a.employee_no) ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id ))[1] AS first_assignee_name FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a LEFT JOIN tb_user um ON um.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND ( CAST(um.user_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no OR CAST(um.login_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no ) WHERE a.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) wa ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(li.login_id AS varchar), ',' ORDER BY li.exe_seq) AS reference_ids_csv FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info li WHERE li.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND li.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'cooperated' AND li.login_id != m.login_id AND COALESCE(li.last_owner_status, '') != 'Y' ) ref ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX( CASE WHEN COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' AND COALESCE(li.app_status, '') IN ('approved', 'returned') THEN li.exe_seq ELSE NULL END ) AS latest_completed_seq, MAX( CASE WHEN li.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' AND COALESCE(li.app_status, '') IN ('approved', 'returned') THEN li.exe_seq ELSE NULL END ) AS actor_latest_completed_seq, MAX( CASE WHEN COALESCE(li.last_owner_status, '') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'cooperated' AND COALESCE(li.app_status, '') = 'confirmed' AND li.exe_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS final_owner_confirmed_flag FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info li WHERE li.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND li.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id ) cancel_perm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN tb_electronic_approval_line_info l1 ON l1.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l1.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l1.exe_seq = 1 AND COALESCE(l1.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' LEFT JOIN tb_electronic_approval_line_info l2 ON l2.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l2.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l2.exe_seq = 2 AND COALESCE(l2.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' LEFT JOIN tb_electronic_approval_line_info l3 ON l3.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l3.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l3.exe_seq = 3 AND COALESCE(l3.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' LEFT JOIN tb_user ru_line ON ru_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND ru_line.login_id = l2.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_user au_line ON au_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND au_line.login_id = l3.login_id WHERE m.electronic_approval_id = #{id} AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_electronic_approval_history_main ( tenant_id, electronic_approval_line_id, parent_history_id, answer_seq, answer_type_name, answer_at, answer_cnt, not_open_status, main_view_status, exe_seq, approval_type, eabus_no, ea_exe_id, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{electronicApprovalLineId}, #{parentHistoryId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{answerSeq}, #{answerTypeName}, #{answerAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{answerCnt}, #{notOpenStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mainViewStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{exeSeq}, #{approvalType}, #{eabusNo}, #{eaExeId}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )

COALESCE(like_me.liked_by_me, FALSE) AS likedByMe, hm.answer_cnt AS text, TO_CHAR(hm.answer_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt, NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(la.profile_image, '')), '') AS actorProfileImage, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(u.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(la.login_code), ''), '시스템' ) AS actorName FROM tb_electronic_approval_history_main hm LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = hm.tenant_id AND u.login_id = hm.created_by LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = hm.tenant_id AND la.login_id = hm.created_by LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, electronic_approval_history_id,
